# Stumble installation instructions for agents

Stumble requires Rust and Cargo. If `cargo` is missing, ask the user to install Rust from https://rustup.rs before continuing.

From the repository root, install the CLI:

```bash
cargo install --path crates/stumble-cli --locked
```

Initialize a Home Node and verify the installation:

```bash
stumble --data-dir ~/.stumble/nodes/home node init
stumble --data-dir ~/.stumble/nodes/home node show
```

The core loop is `stumble add <url>` to save a link (one step, Feed-eligible immediately) and `stumble feed batch get` to read the Feed. See the repository root `SKILL.md` for the full harness workflow, including browsing shared links with the harness's own browser tools.

Start the local HTTP API only when the User asks to run it:

```bash
stumble-api --data-dir ~/.stumble/nodes/home --bind 127.0.0.1:8787
```

Keep the default loopback binding unless the user explicitly requests and understands public exposure. MCP clients launch `stumble-mcp` with either `--transport stdio` or `--transport http`; the one-shot `stumble` executable never launches a server. Use `stumble --help` and `stumble <family> --help` for the five workflow families.
